Method of Attack: SSID Confusion attack involves downgrading victims to a less secure network by spoofing a trusted network name (SSID) to intercept traffic or carry out further attacks.
Impacted Systems: All operating systems and Wi-Fi clients, including home and mesh networks based on WEP, WPA3, 802.11X/EAP, and AMPE protocols.
Attack Vector: Adversary-in-the-middle (AitM) attack by tricking victims into connecting to a rogue network with the same authentication credentials as the trusted network.
